correctness.rationale: Antipodal cyclic gaps give three positive x,y,z summing pi/2. Two equal copies of side lengths 2Rsin x etc. yield L=4R sum sin x and exact Phi=(sum sin x) product cos x / product(sin x+sin y). With m=(x+y)/2, d=(x-y)/2, u=sin m, q=cos d, the asserted expression (2) and factored derivative (3) were independently differentiated in SymPy: exact identity true. The remaining factor B(u,q) is strictly negative on 0<u<1/sqrt(2), sqrt(1-u^2)<q<=1, as the two stated elementary interval bounds show, so every nontrivial pair averaging decreases Phi. Symmetric averaging fixes unique minimum x=y=z=pi/6; boundary x=0 gives Phi=1, approached but not attained, and connected paths give full range. This is a global analytic proof, not a finite grid argument.
